desc:
Black has great thickness. The white stone at <X:Q13> is against the black wall and doesn't work well. So you might think Black's thickness is superior to White's territory. But White got territory in what was Black's corner. That's part of the reason this is playable for White. That and White has sente and can use the cutting stone at <Y:O15> to pressure the black group and erase Black's influence.

See [AGA Master Review Series, Game 35: Master [W] vs. Jiang Weijie 9p [B]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1vVe1pKmhQ4&t=689).
